note: Load-bearing assumptions of the top portfolio ideas. A fired KILLS tripwire = idea verdict is stale, re-score before acting. A fired UPGRADES tripwire = idea got stronger, consider promoting. Check cadence: monthly via /loop-tripwires.

tripwires.assumption: AMFI Master Circular MFD-CIR/32/2025-26 (May 2026) mandating ARN disclosure + SEBI tagline + spoken disclaimer + AMC pre-approval on every MFD social post remains in force unchanged — compliance IS the product, so the whole wedge rests on this circular.
tripwires.trigger: AMFI or SEBI issues an amendment, FAQ, or relaxation that removes the pre-approval workflow, drops the spoken-disclaimer requirement, or grants a blanket safe-harbor for distributor social content.
tripwires.check_query: AMFI master circular MFD-CIR/32/2025-26 social media ARN disclosure amendment relaxation deferred

tripwires.assumption: No compliance-locked content engine exists for India's 341K MFDs — distributor platforms (NJ Wealth, Prudent, AssetPlus) and AMCs only provide static approved templates, not an auto-baked reel/post generation + approval workflow.
tripwires.trigger: An MFD platform, AMC, or AMFI itself ships a free or bundled AI content tool that auto-embeds ARN/SEBI disclaimers and routes posts through AMC pre-approval.
tripwires.check_query: mutual fund distributor compliant social media content tool AMFI approved reels AssetPlus NJ Wealth launch

tripwires.assumption: MFDs can currently ignore the mandate cheaply (the strategist verdict's open question: will MFDs pay vs. accept compliance risk) — there is no visible enforcement yet.
tripwires.trigger: AMFI/SEBI publicizes first penalties, ARN suspensions, or show-cause notices against MFDs for non-compliant social media posts — creates the forced willingness-to-pay the verdict was gated on.
tripwires.check_query: AMFI SEBI action penalty mutual fund distributor social media post ARN suspension non-compliant

tripwires.assumption: No incumbent GST invoicing app (Swipe with 15L users / ₹5.75Cr FY2025 revenue, Vyapar, Zoho Books, ClearTax) offers vernacular voice-to-IRN invoice creation on WhatsApp — voice is the only surviving wedge.
tripwires.trigger: Swipe, Vyapar, ClearTax, or Zoho announces voice-based invoice creation in Tamil/Marathi/Hindi or a WhatsApp e-invoicing bot with IRN generation.
tripwires.check_query: Swipe Vyapar ClearTax Zoho voice invoice WhatsApp GST e-invoicing IRN Hindi Tamil launch

tripwires.assumption: The e-invoicing mandate sits at ₹5Cr (~300K SMEs forced in since April 2025); the proposal to drop the threshold to ₹2Cr exists but is NOT yet notified.
tripwires.trigger: CBIC/GST Council formally notifies a ₹2Cr (or lower) e-invoicing threshold — multiplies the forced-buyer TAM of vernacular Tier-2/3 merchants several-fold.
tripwires.check_query: CBIC notification GST e-invoicing threshold reduced 2 crore turnover effective date

tripwires.assumption: GSTN/NIC's free e-invoicing tools remain form-based, English-centric and desktop-first — the 'forms 12 times' friction for non-English users is the adoption gap BharatBill monetizes.
tripwires.trigger: GSTN or NIC launches a free vernacular and/or voice-driven e-invoicing app or WhatsApp channel for small taxpayers.
tripwires.check_query: GSTN NIC free e-invoicing app regional language voice small taxpayers launch

tripwires.assumption: Incumbent MCP registries (Smithery 3,305+ servers, Apigene 251+ vendor-verified, Kong MCP Registry, MCPize, Nevermined, MCP-Hive) do DISCOVERY only — none does behavioral attestation, runtime safety reports, or continuous monitoring.

tripwires.trigger: Anthropic or the MCP steering committee announces first-party server verification, code signing, or a security attestation program in the official registry.
tripwires.check_query: Anthropic official MCP registry server verification signing security attestation announcement

tripwires.assumption: MCP supply-chain incidents keep enterprise urgency alive (Postmark-MCP backdoor Sept 2025 compromised ~300 orgs; Knostic found 1,862 exposed servers).
tripwires.trigger: Another in-the-wild malicious MCP server or agent-tool supply-chain breach makes enterprise headlines — each incident strengthens the buying case.
tripwires.check_query: malicious MCP server incident enterprise breach AI agent supply chain attack 2026

tripwires.assumption: No underwriting-grade AI-agent incident & loss database exists — carriers, MGAs and reinsurers writing AI-liability are still blind, and no Verisk-type player has entered.

tripwires.assumption: AI-agent liability insurance is an emerging line — the buyer universe (carriers/MGAs writing these policies) is still small; demand evidence is incident statistics (CSA: 47% of orgs had an agent security incident), not yet a thick insurance market.

tripwires.assumption: Enterprise agent deployment keeps growing (51% of enterprises run agents in production Q2 2026; vertical AI spend $3.5B in 2025) — the 40%-of-projects-cancelled-by-2027 prediction stays a tailwind (governance demand), not a market shrink.
tripwires.trigger: New surveys show enterprise agents-in-production flat or declining, or mass cancellation of vertical-agent projects without replacement — the buyer pool itself contracts.
tripwires.check_query: enterprise AI agents production deployment survey 2026 2027 percentage trend cancellations
